member.returns: Returns 201 Created with the newly created enrollment. Returns 400 Bad Request if the input data is invalid.
member.remarks:
POST: api/Enrollments
Example request:
{ "studentID": 1, "courseID": 1, "enrollmentDate": "2026-10-28", "grade": "A", "status": "Active" }
StudentID and CourseID must refer to existing records.
